set system host-name client001.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.2.2/16
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set system domain-name example.com.explanation: Configure the domain name of the device.

parameters.name: domain-name
parameters.explanation: The domain name of the device is used for the interpretation of the domain name in the network.

set system services ssh root-login deny.command: set system services ssh root-login deny
set system services ssh root-login deny.explanation: Configure SSH services does not allow root users to log in.

parameters.name: root-login
parameters.explanation: Controls whether root users can log in via SSH and Deny says no.

set system login user <username> authent.template: set system login user [parameter1] authentication plain-text-password
set system login user <username> authent.command: set system login user <username> authentication plain-text-password
set system login user <username> authent.explanation: Configure the system login user's authentication as an explicit password.

parameters.name: authentication
parameters.explanation: User authentication, plain-text-password indicates use of an express password.

set system services ssh protocol-version.command: set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh protocol-version.explanation: The protocol version that configures SSH services is V2.

parameters.name: protocol-version
parameters.explanation: SSH version, v2 indicates use of SSH version 2.
